steps: Peel the sweet potato, cut it into 2 cm cubes and steam 12 minutes, until a fork slides in easily. Mash it in a large bowl.
Check the salmon for bones with your fingertips, then chop it finely with a knife until it looks like coarse mince.
Slice the green onion thinly and chop the dill. Zest the lemon half.
Add the salmon, green onion, dill and lemon zest to the sweet potato. Mix with a spoon until it holds together when pressed.
Shape into 10 flat cakes about 6 cm across. Chill 10 minutes, until firm.
Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat, about 1 minute, until it shimmers.
Cook the cakes 4 minutes per side, until golden and the salmon inside is opaque all the way through.
Under 12 months, break a cake into small flakes; toddlers eat them whole. Keeps 2 days in the fridge; freezes 1 month.
